{{Quote|He's young, barely into his forties, with a wife and a six-year-old daughter.|Vestin Axlon|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
'''Ferrouz's wife''' was a [[Gender|woman]] who [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the remote [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]]. Together, they had a six-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Ferrouz's daughter|daughter]]. [[Alien/Legends|Alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] kidnapped Ferrouz's wife and daughter as part of a plot to force the governor into [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Empire, but both hostages were eventually rescued by the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].
